title: mentha longifolia subsp. noeana
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. noeana, commonly known as Long-leaved Horsemint or Nana Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, as well as its potential in reducing inflammation and fighting off certain types of bacteria. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia subsp. noeana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and other compounds that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
